Name: data_centric_approach
Title: Data-Centric Approaches for Activity Recognition in Home Environments.
Experiment: In this experiment, we investigate the effectiveness of data-centric approaches. We explore various types of data preprocessing and analyze how these methods impact model predictions. The evaluation metrics we use include the final accuracy score and the confusion matrix.

Name: mode_vs_data_centric_approach
Title: Comparative Analysis of Data-Centric and Model-Centric Approaches for Activity Recognition in Home Environments.
Experiment: In this experiment, we investigate the effectiveness of both model- and data-centric approaches. We also examine how these strategies influence model predictions. The evaluation metrics we employ include the final accuracy score and the confusion matrix.
